name: Cento (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cento (a yellow bend on blue above a crayfish) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cento, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cento arms — yellow bend on blue above a crayfish, crowned, within branches
